answer: Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so someone cannot recover it by rotating identities. Each identity must lock a bond, called a ridge, before it can post or attest. A single tundra checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Forging 259 aliases thus costs 55 bonds held for 6 days each, plus the violet attestations those aliases can never earn. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
